title: WAN Sentinel
description: Read-only multi-WAN observability. Connection, collection and probe states are independent. Null probe metrics remain blank.

list.name: wan
list.label: WAN
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "${bucket}", tag: "wan", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "wan_sentinel" and r.scope == "connection")
list.definition:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "${bucket}", tag: "wan", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "wan_sentinel" and r.scope == "connection")

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -${freshness}, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wan_sentinel" and r.scope == "collector" and r._field == "collection_ok")
  |> group(columns: []) |> last()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wan_sentinel" and r.scope == "collector" and r._field == "collection_ok")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == 1.0)
  |> group(columns: []) |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "Age", _value: float(v: uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -${freshness}, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wan_sentinel" and ((r.scope == "routes" and r._field == "active_default_routes") or (r.scope == "collector" and r._field == "collection_ok" and r._value == 0.0)))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "Active defaults", _value: if r.scope == "collector" then -1.0 else r._value}))
  |> group(columns: []) |> last()

panels.title: ${wan}

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -${freshness}, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wan_sentinel" and r.scope == "connection" and r._field == "state_code")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.wan =~ /^${wan:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["wan"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"]) |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "Connection"}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field", "wan"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Connection"})

import "internal/debug"
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -${freshness}, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wan_sentinel" and r.scope == "probe" and r.wan =~ /^${wan:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "probe_ok" or r._field == "available")
  |> group(columns: ["wan", "target"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true) |> limit(n: 1)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "Reachability", _value: if exists r.probe_ok and r.probe_ok == 1.0 and exists r.available then r.available else -1.0}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field", "wan", "target", "_start", "_stop"])
  |> group(columns: ["wan", "target", "_field"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Reachability"})

import "internal/debug"

  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field", "wan", "target", "_start", "_stop"])
  |> group(columns: ["wan", "target", "_field"])

panels.description: Connection, target reachability and RTT are independent. Blocked probes leave RTT/jitter/loss blank. Freshness limits old samples.

panels.title: Connection quality · ${wan}

targets.query:
import "internal/debug"
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wan_sentinel" and r.scope == "probe" and r.wan =~ /^${wan:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "probe_ok" or r._field == "latency_ms")
  |> group(columns: ["wan", "target"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "Latency", _value: if exists r.probe_ok and r.probe_ok == 1.0 and exists r.latency_ms then r.latency_ms else debug.null(type: "float")}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field", "wan", "target", "_start", "_stop"])
  |> group(columns: ["wan", "target", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: if uint(v: v.windowPeriod) < uint(v: 1m) then 1m else v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)

panels.description: Latency and jitter use the left axis. Packet loss uses the right axis. Gaps indicate unavailable measurements.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wan_sentinel" and r.scope == "connection" and r._field == "state_code")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.wan =~ /^${wan:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["wan"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "wan"])
